synopsis: "Please make me your disciple!!!" Souta, who was about to graduate from high school, felt frustrated that he hadn't become the kind of ideal delinquent he had always imagined. On his way home one day, a lame-looking office worker with a neatly parted hairstyle and glasses who had gotten into trouble with Souta's delinquent friends ended up completely defeating them! To his shock, that office worker turned out to be Morohoshi Keigo, the legendary delinquent Souta had always admired! From that day on, Souta starts visiting Morohoshi whenever he has free time, determined to become his apprentice. Why did he quit being a delinquent? Why is he pretending to be such a lame office worker? As Souta finds himself constantly thinking about Morohoshi, his feelings begin to change in an unexpected way...?! Now reborn as an immortal, she has become a skilled adventurer, capable of decapitating disaster-level monsters and slicing ancient dragons in half with a single stroke. Her true nature, feared as the "The White Shieldmaiden," is that she is incredibly doting on her children!? For her beloved twin daughters, Sofie and Tio, even her adventures are no problem! Ogres flee and dragons tremble in this doting adventure fantasy of the strongest sword demon! (Source: Manga Mirai)

synopsis: When transfer student Sakura Sakuraba arrives in Yuuyamichou, she discovers a place steeped in bizarre, ancient customs. The children there all have strange names and are bound by a curse that prevents them from leaving the city until they graduate high school. Caught in an escalating nightmare, Sakura must navigate curses, summonings, and betrayals. To break the curse and free the children, Sakura teams up with Uzu Andou, the mysterious president of the Paranormal Club. Their strange "club activities" are about to begin! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
